mission_for_D13: Prove which physical substrate or substrate family is information-equivalent to the D12 terminal information frontier. D13 may reject current carriers as insufficient, but may not weaken the frontier because a convenient current artifact lacks the required information.
governing_replay_rule: For every D12-authorized bounded query or discovery replay inside the declared future frontier, the retained physical information must reproduce the exact lawful empirical distinction, support/risk-set/topology/measure/authority/provenance state, or return the same typed unavailable/noncomparable/zero-support result without inventing independence, joins, imputation or actor state.

information_frontier.requirement: Exact scoped population response distributions and configuration masses remain derivable with raw support, denominator and governed measure identity.
information_frontier.carrier_constraint: No dedicated distribution table required if deeper retained information reconstructs the exact distribution.

information_frontier.requirement: Future-authorized empirical-coordinate predicates, conjunctions, response-conditioned predicates and response×coordinate conjunctions remain exactly queryable under same-respondent semantics.
information_frontier.carrier_constraint: Respondent incidence or an information-equivalent representation must cover every dimension the authorized future frontier may combine. A fixed contingency proves only its fixed query.

information_frontier.requirement: Same-respondent pair and higher-order joint response support/mass remains reconstructible for requested bounded arity and for future-selectable target subsets/arity within the authorized frontier.
information_frontier.carrier_constraint: Unary/pairwise summaries are insufficient for general k-way replay. Exact fixed k-way contingency is sufficient only for that fixed target/condition/risk-set.

information_frontier.requirement: Discovered branch/cohort predicates, ancestry and membership remain exactly reconstructible so branch-conditioned distributions and cotravel can be replayed.
information_frontier.carrier_constraint: Branch labels/tree rows alone are insufficient. Immutable membership or deterministic predicate replay over retained respondent information is acceptable in information terms.

information_frontier.requirement: The retained substrate must support autonomous discovery of lawful minority departures, interactions, conditional reversals and recursive forks within a separately governed search frontier, including configurations with no lower-order signal when the declared coverage class includes them.
information_frontier.carrier_constraint: No materialize-all requirement. Rejected/pruned/evaluated candidate replay must be possible at the coverage level claimed by the future authority/algorithm.

information_frontier.requirement: Empirical distinctions across time/wave remain independently replayable with exact harmonization/comparability/proxy provenance so persistence, drift, reversal and rupture are not collapsed into current snapshot.
information_frontier.carrier_constraint: No specific temporal summary artifact required.

information_frontier.requirement: Distinct respondent universes remain separately identifiable and replayable; linkage, overlap, derivation, pooling, harmonization and backfill authority states and double-counting provenance remain recoverable.
information_frontier.carrier_constraint: No false respondent join or naive pooling may be necessary to answer the frontier.

information_frontier.requirement: The physical authority/provenance substrate must retain enough actor-side fact and survey-side coordinate identity plus crosswalk/time/source semantics to reproduce exact actor-fact -> empirical-conditioner comparator receipts or typed no-match/ambiguity.
information_frontier.carrier_constraint: Generated structural position is not an information-equivalent bridge.

information_frontier.requirement: For a fixed lawful generated-subject comparator predicate and source/historical scope, reconstruct the complete requested conditional joint possibility field with support, mass, routing/topology, uncertainty state and provenance.
information_frontier.carrier_constraint: The replay target is a population empirical possibility field, not actor belief/disposition.

information_frontier.requirement: Every empirical fact admitted into structural/stratal production must retain or dereference exact source empirical identity, structural transformation/admission authority and negative/limit authority sufficient to reproduce the structural producer input semantics.
information_frontier.carrier_constraint: Respondent incidence need not cross the structural boundary when an exact admitted empirical fact is independently replayable.

information_frontier.requirement: Risk-set, routing, applicability and denominator semantics remain reconstructible for every authorized query; absence of a row is not sufficient to distinguish zero support, not asked, inapplicable, missing authority or unavailable data.
information_frontier.carrier_constraint: Flexible future risk-set queries require eligibility incidence or information-equivalent relation.

information_frontier.requirement: Response topology and event multiplicity survive: scalar/set/order/repeat/ranked/routed structures and typed DK/refusal/IAP/not-asked/inapplicable/substantive states cannot be irreversibly scalarized or normalized away.
information_frontier.carrier_constraint: A first-row duplicate collapse is insufficient unless topology authority proves scalar singularity.

information_frontier.requirement: Raw support, governed survey weight/measure identity and enough design/method provenance for honest uncertainty state remain reproducible.
information_frontier.carrier_constraint: No universal numeric uncertainty estimator is selected; typed unquantified uncertainty is lawful when estimator authority is absent.

information_frontier.requirement: Exact source/question/response/predicate/risk-set/authority/transformation/version/replay provenance remains retained or immutably dereferenceable for facts and discovery results.
information_frontier.carrier_constraint: Hash/integrity of a declared subset of columns is not itself proof that all frontier information is covered.

distinguish k-way worlds with identical lower-order marginals
supported nonmodal configuration including low support and uncertainty, not top-k disappearance
exact discovered branch predicate/membership and branch-conditioned distribution
set/order/repeated response event without scalar duplicate collapse
same current snapshot but different historical trajectory
source-indexed disagreement without pooling or false join
distinguish independent source from original/derivative or pooled/constituent overlap
exact actor-fact comparator, multiple-match ambiguity and no-match states
bounded conditional joint positioned-subject empirical possibility field
exact empirical fact/provenance admitted by a governed structural producer
authorized candidate frontier and discovery result including pruning/coverage semantics, without requiring all results to be pre-materialized

current_carriers_requiring_D13_hostile_p.known_limit: populated completeness/source equivalence unavailable under no-DB law
logical hash covers declared required columns, not arbitrary future replay; joint-only semantic parity and repeated/multiselect preservation unproved
cannot collectively be assumed information-equivalent to frontier without proof

D13_must_not_assume: current artifact existence implies retention necessity
current artifact absence implies capability unnecessary
logical hash completeness implies semantic replay completeness
normalized field equality implies source/native semantic equality
same respondent-id string implies cross-universe person identity
scalar uniqueness policy is lawful for repeated/multiselect topology
generated structural position can substitute for actor-biography comparator
blocked_empirical_proof: Because populated DB/source-native access is unavailable, D13 must type any end-to-end populated equivalence claim that cannot be demonstrated as UNVERIFIED/BLOCKED rather than infer success or failure from schema alone.
closure_condition_for_D13: Return a finite per-candidate physical replay-sufficiency ruling against R01-R14 and T01-T18, explicitly separating statically/information-theoretically proved sufficiency, identified information loss, and populated/source-equivalence dimensions blocked by unavailable evidence.
